header { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #5f0f16 0%, #7f1d1d 48%, #9f1239 100%); color: white; padding: 1rem 1.5rem 1.15rem; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px var(--shadow); }
header a { color: white; text-decoration: none; margin-right: 1rem; }
.brandline { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; align-items: end; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.top-tabs { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.top-tab { display: inline-block; padding: 0.45rem 0.8rem; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); margin-right: 0; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; }

.card { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--panel) 0%, #fff 100%); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 18px; padding: 1.15rem 1.35rem; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px var(--shadow); margin-bottom: 1rem; }
.toolbar { display: flex; gap: 0.75rem; align-items: end; flex-wrap: wrap; }
label { display: block; font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--ink-soft); margin-bottom: 0.35rem; font-weight: 600; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; }
input, select, textarea { padding: 0.55rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: white; border-radius: 10px; font: inherit; }

button, .btn { display: inline-block; padding: 0.62rem 1rem; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--brand-warm), var(--brand)); color: white; text-decoration: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; }
.btn.ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--brand-deep); border: 1px solid var(--line); }
th, td { text-align: left; padding: 0.6rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #f7d4d2; vertical-align: top; }
.pill { display: inline-block; padding: 0.2rem 0.55rem; border-radius: 999px; background: #fecdd3; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #7f1d1d; margin-right: 0.25rem; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; }
.warn { background:#fee2e2; border:1px solid #f87171; color:#991b1b; padding:0.85rem 1rem; border-radius:12px; margin-bottom:1rem; }
.stat { padding: 1rem 1.1rem; border-radius: 16px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff 0%, var(--panel-2) 100%); border: 1px solid var(--line); }
.stat .label { margin-top: 0.3rem; color: var(--ink-soft); font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; }
.hero { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.7fr) minmax(280px, 0.9fr); gap: 1rem; align-items: stretch; }
.hero-panel { padding: 1.8rem; border-radius: 24px; background: linear-gradient(145deg, #6a1118 0%, #8b1e2b 55%, #b4233a 100%); color: white; box-shadow: 0 14px 36px rgba(95, 15, 22, 0.28); }
.hero-side { padding: 1.4rem; border-radius: 24px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff 0%, #fff3ef 100%); border: 1px solid var(--line); box-shadow: 0 14px 36px rgba(95, 15, 22, 0.12); }

.analytics-consent { position: fixed; z-index: 1000; right: 1rem; bottom: 1rem; max-width: 34rem; padding: 1rem 1.15rem; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 18px 46px rgba(53,19,19,.24); font-family: Arial, sans-serif; }
.analytics-consent-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: .55rem; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: .85rem; }

INPHARED2 is the new home of the INPHARED resource, providing a curated, regularly updated set of complete bacteriophage genomes with associated metadata and genome quality information, including CheckV assessments and taxonomy generated using taxMyPhage.

Building on the original database, INPHARED2 provides an expanded and improved reference resource for phage genomics; the updated resource and analysis are described in our INPHARED2 preprint. It provides an easy-to-use online search function alongside bulk data downloads. The online database was last updated on 03 October 2026
